headline: Product Designer — B2B SaaS, automation & AI interfaces
summary: Product designer with 8+ years in product and UX/UI design. Designed a workflow builder, AI agent interfaces and a 150+ component design system for a SaaS product used by ~10,000 users. Based in Berlin; English C1, German B2.

paragraphs: Your automation builder is the kind of product I like designing most: dense, logical, and used every day by people who want to get work done.

At API Nation I designed a Workflow Builder that replaced manual automation setup — customers set things up faster and support requests went down. I also built a 150+ component design system that the whole team used as the source of truth.
Since AI features are on your roadmap: I have designed interfaces for AI agents, and I use AI in my own design workflow every day, including an open-source Claude Code kit for designers.
I'm based in Berlin and would be glad to walk you through these case studies.
